## Formula and implementation audit

b=1(z>0);q=z/||z||2. Development incidence delta=mean32(bB−bA),amplitude delta=mean32[coactive*(qB−qA)];W=abs(delta)/sumabs(delta),S=sign(delta). Shared masses=coactive;incidence masses=W*abs(bB−bA);amplitude masses=W*coactive*abs(qB−qA). Per-family profile denominator=sum nonnegative masses;zero produces missing profile. Signed replication=sumW*S*(actual difference),fixeddenominator1. All30000 coordinates eligible,exactzero developmentweight remains0.

The main coarse-minus-fine contrast uses only jointly defined families and explicitly reports its denominator. Whole64-family bootstrap preserves missingness masks. All24 hypotheses per reference remain in multiplicity correction irrespective of eligibility. Confirmation matrices are read only after development lock. Cached scoring agrees with full two-token teacher forcing below1e-4; original prefix native representations also agree below1e-4. Native encoder/ReLU/Top32 equality and32strictly-positive outputs are asserted for every encoded row.

## Scientific reading update

# S11: shared and distinguishing members do not follow one frequency ladder

The new data support a relative decrease in mean independent-reference frequency of shared members for fine contrasts, but not a universal decrease for distinguishing members. Low-frequency coordinates and very frequent coordinates can participate in the same fine contrast. These are bounded representation observations, not semantic mechanisms or routing utility.

Purpose and data: animal(cat/dog),vehicle(car/bicycle),fruit(apple/banana),furniture(chair/sofa);96new frames,32development/64confirmation,12labels×4wordings=4608primary prefixes,plus96prospectively fixed position/phrase controls on the same frames. Independent new reference documents:6000questions(2000each Magicoder problem,GSM8K question,MMLU question) and6000DCLM documents, kept as separate frequency axes. These are frequency references,not a new S08source-overlap experiment. Fixed official Qwen3-0.6B Base, native30000/ReLU/Top32 attention-output and MLP-input dictionaries atblock27; final Description:colon. No old activation counts as new; no training/interventions/router.

Both profiles are common in absolute reference terms; relative decrease does not imply a rare-feature group.

Attentionfruits and MLPfruits differ. No new quartile criterion rescues these primary verdicts.

H3:local descriptive support for membership and amplitude associations; insufficient evidence for a mechanism beyond marginals. All16frozen fine incidence/amplitude projections replicate in explicit confirmation underHolm16. Full selected-common-list coverage meets both32/64family criteria in only3/8site/domain conditions; no separately refitted list-normalized direction or nonlinear-combination claim is made. Primary decisions remain unchanged.

Definitions and inference:identical positive-support intersections for all pairs;equal-coordinate then equal-family weighting for sharing.
